title: Add-to-meal-plan service: new plan creation
description: Extend the service with the create-new-plan flow, including name sanitisation, duplicate-file handling, initial block seeding, recipe insertion, quantity calculation, and serialise/write behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The service can create a new `.menu` file under the plans folder with a sanitised plan name and caller-provided first section name.
Duplicate plan filenames are detected before write and surfaced as a recoverable error path.
Recipe quantity uses servings × scale when servings metadata is available and omits quantity when it is not.

handoff_summary.completed: 1. Added `.duplicatePlan` error case to `MutationError`. 2. Added `createNewPlan(recipeURL:recipesFolder:folderURL:planName:firstSectionName:servings:scaleFactor:)` that: sanitises name (trim + replace `/` with `-`), resolves plans folder via `MealPlanFiles.plansURL`, checks `FileManager.fileExists` before write and throws `.duplicatePlan` if collision, computes `Quantity(value: .number(Double(s) * scaleFactor), unit: "servings")` when `servings != nil` else `nil`, builds a `MealPlan` with one `MealPlanBlock` / one default `MealPlanSection` containing the recipe item, serialises via `MealPlanParser.serialise`, writes via `String.write(to:atomically:encoding:)` within the `folderURL` security scope bracket.
handoff_summary.remaining: UI wiring: `AddToMealPlanSheet` (the sheet view presenting plans + blocks + create-new flow) and `RecipeBottomBar` / `RecipeDetailSheet` wiring are not yet implemented — they are out of scope for this service-only bead and belong to the UI bead in the same feature root.
handoff_summary.risks: The security-scoped resource bracket is placed on `folderURL` (not the new file URL), matching the pattern in `MealPlansView.handleCreate()`. If the caller omits a valid security-scoped `folderURL` the write will silently fail with a permission error wrapped in `.writeFailed`. The SourceKit 'No such module CookbookCore' diagnostic is a false positive from the worktree context; the import was pre-existing.
handoff_summary.next_action: A UI bead should implement `AddToMealPlanSheet` and wire `RecipeBottomBar` / `RecipeDetailSheet` to call `createNewPlan` (passing `recipe.metadata.servings?.first` and the current scale factor) as well as the existing `addToBlock` / `addNewBlock` methods.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. Only `AddToMealPlanService.swift` was modified; the new method is purely additive. No sibling bead touches this file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Security scope is bracketed on `folderURL` (not the new file URL) because the new file doesn't exist yet and has no security-scoped bookmark — mirrors the identical pattern in `MealPlansView.handleCreate()`. Quantity is computed inside the service (not pre-computed by caller) to keep the quantity rule close to the write logic and match the spec's intent.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tests for `createNewPlan` (duplicate detection, quantity rendering at 2× scale, quantity omission when servings is nil, path encoding) should be added in `CookbookAppTests/AddToMealPlanServiceTests.swift` by the tester bead.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The `servings` parameter takes `Int?` (first element from `Metadata.servings: [Int]?`); multi-value servings arrays (e.g. `servings: 2, 4`) use only the first value — consistent with the spec's intent of using a single base count.

conflict_risks: None. Only `AddToMealPlanService.swift` was modified; the new method is purely additive. No sibling bead touches this file.

execution_history.summary: Added `createNewPlan` method and `duplicatePlan` error case to `AddToMealPlanService`. The method sanitises the plan name, detects duplicates before write, computes recipe quantity as servings × scaleFactor when servings metadata is available, builds a typed `MealPlan` in memory, serialises it, and writes to `folderURL/plans/<sanitised>.menu` with the correct security-scoped resource bracket on `folderURL`.
